headword: {針小棒大|しんしょうぼうだい}
gloss: making a mountain out of a molehill

definitions.gloss: making a mountain out of a molehill; exaggeration
definitions.explanation: To exaggerate a small matter into something much larger; to blow things out of proportion. Literally: making a needle (small) into a stick (large).

examples.japanese: ⟦マスコミ→マスコミ：03872_masukomi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{針小棒大|しんしょうぼうだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{報道|ほうどう}→報道：04438_houdou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The media sometimes exaggerates in their reporting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧⟦ミス→ミス：00285_misu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{針小棒大|しんしょうぼうだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{騒|さわ}ぎ{立|た}てない→騒ぎ立てる：29386_sawagitateru⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ほしい→欲しい：01107_hoshii⟧。
examples.english: I wish they wouldn't make such a big deal out of a small mistake.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧{針小棒大|しんしょうぼうだい}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{話半分|はなしはんぶん}→話半分：29387_hanashihanbun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦おこう→置く：01092_oku⟧。
examples.english: His stories are always exaggerated, so take them with a grain of salt.

notes:
STRUCTURE: ⟦{針|はり}→針：03566_hari⟧ (needle) + {小|しょう} (small) + ⟦{棒|ぼう}→棒：03726_bou⟧ (stick/rod) + {大|だい} (large). The idiom compares a needle (something tiny) being described as a stick or rod (something much larger).

USAGE: Used as a noun or adverb (with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧) to describe exaggeration or overstatement.
- {針小棒大|しんしょうぼうだい}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧ (an exaggerated story)
- {針小棒大|しんしょうぼうだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ (to exaggerate)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{大|おお}げさ→大げさ：19918_oogesa⟧ (exaggerated, dramatic)
- ⟦{誇張|こちょう}→誇張：08680_kochou⟧ (exaggeration)
- ⟦{控|ひか}えめ→控えめ：17234_hikaeme⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ (to understate)
